LESSON: MIRACLE OF HEALING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.4: Miracle of Healing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Miracle of Healing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did the bleeding woman portray faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman
2. identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society
3. appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MIRACLE OF HEALING
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Miracle of Healing helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MIRACLE OF HEALING
Study Miracle of Healing like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Miracle of Healing” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society

What this means
In this part you learn to identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Miracle of Healing in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Miracle of Healing is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Miracle of Healing” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Miracle of Healing in your own words. (skill: identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Miracle of Healing to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman.
3. Practise this skill: identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the healing power of Jesus Christ in their lives.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Miracle of Healing from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Miracle of Healing: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Miracle of Healing?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did the bleeding woman portray faith in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Miracle of Healing means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman.
5. Be able to: identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
